name: Ideal Capital Berhad
summary: Ideal Capital Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the property development business in Malaysia. It operates through three segments: Property Development; Trading; and Project Investment and Project Management. The company engages in the trading of heavy machinery and spare parts, and disinfectant products; property investment and management; and asset management activities. It also provides energy management services; manufactures and trades in sterilisation and sanitisation, and pharmaceutical products; develops industrial parks; and trades in industrial land and building materials, as well as engages in the rental business.
